subtitle: Computer Science Graduate | Building practical tools for real-world problems
about: I'm a Computer Science graduate from Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications (NJUPT) with a passion for building practical software that solves real problems. My work spans full-stack web development, embedded systems, and data visualization — from internal tools at a manufacturing plant to robotics teaching assistantships. I enjoy learning new technologies independently and turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions.
